name: Waiting for host
summary: The centred "waiting for the presenter" screen for the lobby and passive phases: a gently breathing hourglass, a headline and a muted sub-line, all in the deck ink.
highlights: Copy and translation stay with the caller
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-waiting-for-host> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.
